newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas futures set record trade Weds.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas futures set record trade Weds.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange said Henry Hub natural gas futures set a daily volume record Wednesday when 99,742 contracts traded.
The activity surpassed the previous record of 97,916 set on December 21, 1995, NYMEX said in a statement Thursday.

"In 1996, we have watched the Henry Hub contract become the second most actively traded energy contract on the exchange. Volume for the year is at a record pace once again, up 12 percent over last year," NYMEX president Pat Thompson said in the statement.
